description:
Watch videos together, perfectly in sync, no matter where your friends and family are. 

SyncTogether is a modern, low-latency shared media player crafted specifically for macOS. Whether you're streaming YouTube videos or watching local movies from your Mac, SyncTogether keeps everyone's playback in lockstep. When someone plays, pauses, or seeks, everyone stays synchronized automatically.

KEY FEATURES:

• STRICT LOCKSTEP PLAYBACK
Synchronization engine with automatic drift correction and readiness gating. Play, pause, scrub, and seek together without getting out of sync. Late joiners are instantly synced to the host's current position.

• TWO VERSATILE PLAYBACK MODES
- YouTube Integration: Paste any public YouTube link or playlist to start watching together immediately.
- Local Video Files: Watch MP4, MKV, MOV, WebM, and other video files on your drive with hardware-accelerated playback. Built-in hash verification ensures everyone is watching the exact same file.

• LIVE VOICECAMS & FACECAMS
Bring your watch party to life! Multi-participant live audio and video tiles let you see and hear your friends' real-time reactions right alongside the video without leaving the app.

• REAL-TIME CHAT & ANIMATED REACTIONS
Engage during the stream with built-in instant messaging, live typing indicators, and expressive animated emoji reactions that float across the screen.

• INSTANT ROOMS & INVITE LINKS
Create private watch party rooms in seconds. Share a simple 6-character room code or send an invite link (synctogether://join/code) for one-click joining.

• PRIVACY-FIRST & SECURE
No ads, and your personal data is never sold. Join instantly as an anonymous guest with one click, or sign in securely with Apple ID, Google, or Email OTP.

• NATIVE MACOS EXPERIENCE
Tailored for macOS with keyboard shortcuts, picture-in-picture, full-screen theater mode, and a distraction-free dark cinema aesthetic.

Start your next movie night or video watch party today with SyncTogether!

SYNCTOGETHER PATRON (OPTIONAL)
Patron is an auto-renewing subscription, available monthly or yearly, that unlocks up to 16 watchers per room, up to 20 active rooms, persistent rooms, video facecams, watch sessions up to 24 hours and extended animated reactions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://synctogether.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://synctogether.app/privacy
promotionalText: Movie night, even when you're apart. Watch your own video files or YouTube in perfect sync, with voice and facecams beside the film. Free on Mac.
